lengxiqwq/capslock-ime-switcher.description: 按下 CapsLock，轻松切换中英文输入法，支持多输入法，多种软件兼容，快乐编码！🎉 Press CapsLock to switch between Chinese and English IMEs with ease. Multi-IME support, compatible with many apps, happy coding!

lengxiqwq/live-photo-box.description: Live Photo Box（实况照片工具箱） — A Windows desktop solution for processing Live Photos across different devices, brands, and platforms, with powerful conversion and editing capabilities. | 面向 Windows 的实况照片处理工具，帮助不同设备、品牌与平台之间自由转换和处理实况照片，并尽可能保留原始照片的细节与信息。

lengxiqwq/playlistout.description: Playlist Out（歌单导出助手）— 主流音乐平台歌单解析与多格式导出工具，支持 TXT / CSV / Excel / JSON 等格式｜Playlist parser and multi-format exporter for major music platforms, supporting TXT, CSV, Excel, JSON, and more.
